evidence.text: Proven explicit Go release install with published checksum, module download and production build.
Affected base packages: policy, reportdoc, state, runner.
CI pins golangci-lint v2.14.0; install the versioned release and verify its published checksums.

settings.development_install: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/golangci-lint-2.14.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/releases/download/v2.14.0/golangci-lint-2.14.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/lint-checksums.txt https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/releases/download/v2.14.0/golangci-lint-2.14.0-checksums.txt && (cd /tmp && grep "golangci-lint-2.14.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz$" lint-checksums.txt | sha256sum -c -) && tar -C /tmp -xzf /tmp/golangci-lint-2.14.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz && install -m 755 /tmp/golangci-lint-2.14.0-linux-amd64/golangci-lint /usr/local/bin/golangci-lint
